guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: currencyservice_socket is the only series with a large deviation (+160.7%, z=+32.13, from 3 to 7.82), and every one of the 5 slowest traces (1.3-1.5 s) passes through currencyservice. Logs contain no warnings or errors and no trace shows error spans, so the evidence is purely metric-based; the other services' metrics (including productcatalogservice) are flat, so they look like downstream victims rather than the source.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect currencyservice's open connections/sockets for a leak or stuck connections, and restart or roll back the currencyservice pod if the socket count keeps growing. Restarting one replica is reversible and does not delete data.
